rapport_notes: Danah is professional and organized but somewhat transactional; minimal warmth or personality, mostly mechanics and data collection.
process_discipline_notes: No violations detected — no differentiators repeated, no premature re-pitching.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep launches directly into availability check and logistics probing ('Can I have the zip code for the pickup') with no time-boxed framing or promise of an accurate quote in return.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Asked after logistics probing: 'Do you have like, any concerns besides having to want this to do in one day? Anything else that maybe you want to talk about on this call today?' — placed well into the call after zip codes, square footage, and two-day-move discussion.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Mario raises one concern ('I really like to get it all done in one day but I guess it's okay'). Danah acknowledges and attempts follow-up: 'do you have like, any concerns besides...' which draws 'No concerns.' One concern raised, one follow-up attempt, customer closes it out. Scores as 'full' because customer indicated nothing more to dig into.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Danah gives a frame ('typically for home of your size') and hints at a range ('two day move'), but does not deliver a specific anchor range with hours/movers before routing to walkthrough. Partial credit for the reasoning ('the drive time it's about almost five hours').
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: None of the five Save Your Ass lines delivered — call routes to walkthrough before Stage 3 closes.
evidence_quotes.close: No rate-lock line, no explicit ask. Call transitions cleanly to walkthrough: 'So we'll be dropping this call then give me like, two to three minutes, I'll just generate the virtual walkthrough link, I'll text it to you.' This is a correct handoff by design, not an abandonment.

top_strength: Danah cleanly routed a 1700→1200 sq ft move to a virtual walkthrough without abandoning the call or losing the customer, and stayed organized through profile creation and address collection.
coaching_note: Lead with a quid pro quo framing (time commitment + promise of an accurate quote) before probing, and ask the agenda question before diving into logistics — this call went straight to zip codes and square footage without establishing trust or learning priorities first.
